findings.statement: BOUNDED PASS after the required self-discover, step-back, metacognitive self-ask, CoVe, adversarial self-ask, CCoT, and PDR audit: current module bytes 760a7c04 implement exactly six pair-conversion chart members, one forward/reverse pair for each unordered flavour pair, each at K_t/16. Their combined target-directed coefficient accounting exactly reproduces the frozen 48-row K_t/32 catalogue. Under reversal, K_t=(p1.p4)(p2.p3), the invariant phase-space measure, the Pauli gain-minus-loss factor, and the signed four-leg weak action map to the same continuum contribution, so the two half-weight charts are a consistent Reynolds average rather than a new physical channel. The raw event tuple set is not literally S3/CP closed because one representative is chosen modulo simultaneous incoming and outgoing leg exchange; it is exactly closed under all six flavour permutations and CP after quotienting by that kernel- and sign-preserving exchange. On current HEAD the focused tests pass 3/3, a fresh GL48 E1--E5 execution reproduces the retained report bit-for-bit numerically (e/mu residual 3.525406360939371e-11, single-chart control 1.0000171560718123, mu/tau residual 2.447560236182917e-11, number ratio 6.560719562181335e-17, energy ratio 2.3321774904894606e-15, first-law residual 0, entropy production 9.691739087718254e-18, common-state H-normalized number/energy 5.8980696702487084e-12/1.4820594018942042e-11), and an independent low-order asymmetric check gives self-sector S3 residuals <=1.45e-13, CP <=3.94e-14, positive entropy production, and zero event first-law residual. Strongest PASS steelman: exact source accounting, analytic reversal equivalence, prospective contract, current-byte replay, asymmetric symmetry checks, and the order-one single-chart falsifier jointly identify and remove the discretization-orientation artifact. Strongest FAIL steelman: covariance, conservation, equilibrium null, and entropy sign are invariant under common positive rescaling and can be non-discriminating for a zero or incomplete map; E5 is largely an internal event identity; historical D-053 envelopes remain bound to the old row-6 claim ID; and no repository-independent V-A trace, absolute phase-space normalization, or physical catalogue-completeness proof exists. D-059 correctly handles this by registering a new bounded claim without rewriting history. Therefore C-F10-ROW9-CLOSURE is VALIDATED only as a tested discretization repair on the frozen specified catalogue. It cannot by itself certify absolute normalization, physical catalogue completeness, general-state/continuum correctness, covariance-metrology, trajectory/endpoint authority, production, or public science. Decisive reopen falsifiers are: a missing reverse chart; any coefficient other than 16; failure of exact target-row reconstruction; failure of reversal/sign equivalence; E3/E4 above 1e-10; a conservation, strict-open, entropy-sign, CP, or common-state-null regression; or independent trace/normalization evidence contradicting K_t/32.
